driveSpeed.note: Logged drive time ÷ the drawing's time; 0.83-1.25 on 2 Nov (1.5 was the light chassis).

spinUpS.note: Median of 83 spin-ups to launch speed; 0.9-2.1 s, slowest on a low battery.

volleyS.note: 8 LaunchAlls after a drive: 3.6-4.6 s, median 4.0 (settle, speed, the set 3.5 s feed); last ball 1.7-2.9 s after the gate opened.

cellCheckS.note: Quick-check limit for "Wait for TIP or CELL up" on arrival: the camera saw the CELL up 0.22-0.44 s after the drive ended.

intakeFullS.note: Last piece a median 1.5 s after the push starts, plus about 0.4 s to latch full.

tipStartS.source: measured, Belding Qualifier video and L-NoCross logs, 7 Nov 2026
tipStartS.note: The rocker moved 2.3-2.9 s after the last ball left (flight 0.5 s, dwell 1.8-2.4 s); a set 3.5 s feed ends about 1.2 s after its last ball.

tipSwingS.source: measured, Belding Qualifier video and L-NoCross logs, 7 Nov 2026
tipSwingS.note: Swing 1.0-1.4 s, then 0.3-0.5 s for the camera to read the CELL up. With tipStartS: last ball to CellUp about 4.2 s.

tipLoad.note: Field Setup Guide 12.3: an empty raised CELL tips on 8 POLLEN.

startLoad.note: 3 NECTAR start in the raised CELL, so the 3rd POLLEN tips it.

volleyLoad.note: 4 POLLEN if every shot lands; lower it for misses.

partnerTipLagS.source: measured, Belding Qualifier video and L-NoCross logs, 7 Nov 2026
partnerTipLagS.note: Partner's last shot leaving to our CellUp: 4.0, 4.2, 4.4 s (about 4.3 in a fourth); 4.5 errs long.
